note: The wording build_tree_context.py publishes for data release 6.3 (--texts), as release 6.3's comparison tables carry it.

population.description: Crowns in this release with a benefit estimate and a crown replacement time, one per crown. Left out: crowns under 5 m, crowns with no crown estimate, crowns whose height is not plausible or is to check, and crowns whose record-to-crown link is flagged.
population.short: classed crowns with a benefit estimate
population.rule: published service rows minus not classed (under 5 m, no estimate, height not plausible) minus height checks and flagged record links (v63_checks.excluded_markers(c, "comparisons")); one row per marker, no crown key twice

counts_note: Counts per group of the crowns in that group; irreplaceability counts are retired in v6.3.
